scripts.sync-web: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join(__dirname,'../student_client/build/web'); const dest=path.join(__dirname,'public'); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true}); console.log('✅ Flutter web build copied to backend/public successfully');"
scripts.sync-admin: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join(__dirname,'../admin-dashboard/dist'); const dest=path.join(__dirname,'public/admin'); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true}); console.log('✅ Admin dashboard build copied to backend/public/admin successfully');"
scripts.sync-all: npm run sync-web && npm run sync-admin
